uplink.description: live GNSS fix (northern/eastern hemisphere): 22.70935 N, 114.25126 E, battery 3.7 V, RTC timestamp
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame over the 24-byte layout upstream reads (bytes 22/23 included). lat 0x0022A6D7 = 2270935 / 100000 = 22.70935 with bytes[16]=0 (N); lon 0x00AE5566 = 11425126 / 100000 = 114.25126 with bytes[21]=0 (E). Same key set as the byte-identical makerfabs/gps-tracker-pa1010d sibling.

uplink.description: live GNSS fix in the southern/western hemispheres: -33.44890, -70.66930 (exercises the hemisphere bytes upstream ignores)
uplink._note: Regression vector for the fixed upstream bug: upstream derives the hemisphere from the always-positive magnitude (`nsHemi = latitude < 0 ? 'S' : 'N'` after the magnitude has been read) and then calls Math.abs on both coordinates, so it can never report S or W — every southern/western fix comes out mirrored into the northern/eastern hemisphere. This codec reads the hemisphere flags: bytes[16]=1 -> South, bytes[21]=1 -> West. lat magnitude 0x003309FA = 3344890 -> -33.4489; lon magnitude 0x006BD532 = 7066930 -> -70.6693.

uplink.description: no GNSS fix (gpsStatus=0): battery and g-sensor only, position and time suppressed
uplink._note: bytes[4]=0 means no live fix, so position.* is suppressed rather than reported as 0,0 (a false fix in the Gulf of Guinea). Whole-device readings still decode.
